description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers draining the parked back room: re-checking roadmaps in agents/roadmaps/later/ and skipped/ against the current tree, running their resume conditions, and promoting, absorbing or archiving them so the folders shrink. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours that each own a different surface: /roadmap:next (selects among ACTIVE roadmaps and ships one), /roadmap:process-full (executes a named roadmap), /analyze:inbox (analyzes a dropped agents/tmp/ artifact, not a parked roadmap), archiving a single just-finished active roadmap, and a read-only dashboard question.
